name: bahaospanov
description: Bakhtiyar Ospanov's Claude Code mods, built on function hooks.

plugins.name: lean-repo
plugins.description: Keeps one-time docs, on-demand scripts and diff-restating commit bodies out of the repo: Haiku reviews, called only when the path or command qualifies.

plugins.name: git-gates
plugins.description: Gates git work: no commit, push or merge without the user's say-so in their latest message; commit messages and MR descriptions kept tidy.

plugins.name: lean-comments
plugins.description: Keeps comments and doc prose lean: flags comment-heavy edits, blocks doc lines that repeat facts in code, and sends a follow-up when a turn's diff is over budget.
